name: statmap-dev
description: Dev-only tooling for StatMap. THE GAME ITSELF HAS NO DEPENDENCIES — it is one self-contained HTML file and the deployed Worker imports nothing but its own two JSON files. Everything here exists to run the regression suites, which drive a real headless browser because that is the only way to test a game whose entire behaviour is in the DOM. Nothing in this file is shipped to a player.

scripts.test: node reference/verify.mjs && node reference/polish.mjs && node reference/restore.mjs && node reference/security.mjs
